# OXC v0.17.1 - Table of Contents

Elixir bindings for the OXC JavaScript toolchain — parse, transform, minify, and bundle JS/TS via Rust NIFs.

## Pages

- [OXC](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [OXC](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.md): Elixir bindings for the [OXC](https://oxc.rs) JavaScript toolchain.
- [OXC.Bundle](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Bundle.md): Composable JavaScript bundling pipeline.
- [OXC.Bundle.Entry](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Bundle.Entry.md): Bundle entry configuration.
- [OXC.Bundle.Output](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Bundle.Output.md): A generated bundle output chunk or asset.
- [OXC.Bundle.Result](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Bundle.Result.md): Result of a bundle run.
- [OXC.Format](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Format.md): Format JavaScript/TypeScript source code with oxfmt.
- [OXC.Lint](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.md): Lint JavaScript/TypeScript source with oxlint's built-in rules
and optional custom Elixir rules.
- [OXC.Lint.Rule](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.Rule.md): Behaviour for custom lint rules in Elixir.
- [OXC.Lint.TypeAware](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.TypeAware.md): Runs type-aware TypeScript lint rules through tsgolint headless mode.
- [OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Config](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Config.md): Files and rules submitted to tsgolint.
- [OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Diagnostic](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Diagnostic.md): Normalized type-aware lint diagnostic.
- [OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Payload](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Payload.md): tsgolint headless payload.
- [OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Rule](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Lint.TypeAware.Rule.md): Rule entry submitted to tsgolint.
- [OXC.Native](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Native.md)

- Exceptions
  - [OXC.Error](https://oxc.hexdocs.pm/OXC.Error.md)
